package.name: jetson_driver
package.description:
Full-stack autonomous driving nodes for the Jetson Orin Nano.
Ports the modular CARLA driver (perception + planner + FSM + YOLOv11-small) to ROS 2 Humble, plus two serial bridge nodes that talk to: * a "trigger" ESP32 that signals when to start the parking maneuver (publishes std_msgs/String "go" on /start_parking, identical contract to the Gazebo parking_sim stack), and * a "motor" ESP32 that drives one DC motor (rear wheels, throttle) and one servo (front wheels, steering) over USB serial.
